facts.fact: FAO Kenya reports the Ngong Land Registrar said online stamp-duty payments through Ardhi Pay under the National Stamp Duty Management System have strengthened traceability of land transactions.
facts.system: Ardhi Pay / National Stamp Duty Management System

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands, Public Works, Housing and Urban Development

facts.fact: FAO Kenya reports the EU- and FAO-co-financed Digital Land Governance Programme is sorting, barcoding and scanning land records in 10 registries in Kajiado, Baringo and Machakos counties as part of ongoing digitisation.

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands, Public Works, Housing and Urban Development with EU and FAO

KEN.note: Business continuity training is only said to be planned; no backup site named.
